project.title: Cloud Centre of Expertise / Cloud Operations

parentsummary.deliverables: Architected, implemented, and maintained the AAFC Cloud Centre of Expertise managed AWS Landing Zone environment, delivering IaC governance resources, ITSG-22/33/38-aligned security and compliance tooling, automated Security Control Systems and Posture Management, Azure AD SSO federation, and CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps and AWS CodePipeline — achieving full ATO status for production workloads.
parentsummary.outcomes: Achieved full Authority to Operate (ATO) for Agriculture Canada's AWS Cloud environment, implementing automated security and governance compliance tooling that exceeded GoC cloud guardrails and enabling secure, scalable cloud adoption across the department with integrated Azure AD SSO federation.

challenge.summary: The Cloud Operations workstream needed to design and implement IaC-driven governance and compliance tooling that met ITSG-22, ITSG-33, and ITSG-38 requirements across the AAFC AWS Landing Zone environment — including automated security posture management, Azure AD SSO federation, and full ATO evidence packages for production workloads — on a part-time engagement model requiring disciplined delivery management across a 32-month period.

deliverables: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development and review
CI/CD pipeline implementation via Azure DevOps Repos, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy
Implementation of IT Security Program to meet ITSG-22, ITSG-33 and ITSG-38 and TBS driven cloud guardrails and achieve Full ATO
Implemented and secured SSO Federation to Azure Active Directory, enabling centralized identity management across the AAFC AWS Landing Zone
Developed and implemented Security Control Systems and Posture Management for AWS Cloud Identity components, validating continuously against ITSG Controls
Design and integration of automated Security and Governance compliance tooling, meeting and exceeding GoC ITSG requirements
Facilitated requirements gathering with technical team, architecture team, and security team
Source Code Management within Azure DevOps (Git) Repos
DevOps integration with DevOps tooling, methodology, and processes
Documentation, Knowledge transfer and cross-training with team, new staff and onboarded clients

outcomes: ✅ Achieved full ATO (Authority to Operate) status for Agriculture Canada's AWS Cloud environment, meeting ITSG-22/33/38 requirements

✅ Successfully implemented automated security and governance compliance tooling that exceeded GoC cloud guardrails, enabling secure cloud adoption across the department with integrated Azure AD SSO federation

items: Amazon AWS (AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, AWS SSO, AWS Config, AWS CloudTrail, AWS GuardDuty, AWS IAM, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CloudFormation, Terraform)
